stop: The radio stop (D37, D55): the ER3C-i receiver (failsafe: no pulses) drives one Pololu RC relay switch; its contact feeds the coil of the stop relay (Omron G2RL-2, DPDT, 12 V), whose other end goes to ground through the MCU's MOSFET. The relay holds only while the radio says run AND the MCU says run. Pole A is the turret's dry safety loop (TM pins 7, 8: the turret cuts its flywheels and dial in 20 ms), pole B is in the turret's bus branch (W22, W34: the independent cut); the MCU senses the coil voltage and sits the robot down when the radio drops, and opens the relay itself when the robot sits. The main switch is the hard off.
